# PlayPets

> PlayPets is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop pet app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It reads Codex pet files as they are, lets up to 12 pets share one yard and the desktop, lets them talk with you and with each other through an AI you choose, and has them react while a coding agent works.

- Codex pets: "Codex pet" is the common name for the custom pets made for ChatGPT and Codex; OpenAI calls the feature Pets. PlayPets reads the same pet files (a `pet.json` and a sprite sheet) with every action, and the sixteen look directions when the sheet has them. Codex is not needed. PlayPets is not affiliated with OpenAI; ChatGPT and Codex are trademarks of OpenAI.
- Many pets at once: up to 12 friends in the yard and on the desktop. The ChatGPT desktop app shows the one pet you pick ([OpenAI's pet guide](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pets), October 2026). Four starter pets (Daisy, Clover, Pip, Miso) also dig, plant, fish and wear seasonal outfits.
- Coding agents: reacts to Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Grok Build and other MCP tools through local hooks.
- The yard: four places or your own backgrounds; time of day, weather and seasons; gifts and decorations friends visit; hide and seek, parade and tag; digging, planting, fishing, bug catching and an album.
- Chat: a signed-in Claude Code or Codex CLI, local Ollama, or an OpenAI-compatible server. Games and gardening need no AI account.
- Languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese.

## Guide

- [Install](https://playpets.gaerae.com/guide/install): Microsoft Store, winget, Homebrew and direct downloads
- [FAQ](https://playpets.gaerae.com/guide/faq): cost, privacy, Codex pets, troubleshooting
- [Bring in Codex pets](https://playpets.gaerae.com/guide/import): community sites, GitHub folders and folders on disk
- [Coding agents](https://playpets.gaerae.com/guide/agents): what each agent reports and how to connect it
- [Chat](https://playpets.gaerae.com/guide/chat): AI connections and what they cost
